يصطدموا (form VIII)
# يَصْطَدِمُوا (yaṣṭadimū) /jasˤ.tˤa.di.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# يُصْطَدَمُوا (yuṣṭadamū) /jusˤ.tˤa.da.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
